known.title: Both mandatory validators reject every input on Windows

findings.body:
chunk 2/2:

On native Windows, Node does not expose `O_NOFOLLOW` or `O_NONBLOCK` ([Node documentation](https://nodejs.org/docs/latest-v22.x/api/fs.html#file-open-constants)), so this guard always throws, including for a valid empty-array ledger. `validate-findings.cjs` has the same guard, as do the shipped host copies. Consequently, a Windows user cannot pass the mandatory ledger validation before hunting or complete the audit workflow. Provide a safe Windows validation path and test successful validation too: the added CLI test only expects exit code 1 for invalid input, so this unconditional refusal passes it.
